title: Red Hat Security Advisory: resteasy security update
description: Two security vulnerabilities were addressed in RESTEasy, a JBoss project for building RESTful Web Services and Java applications. The first is an unbounded image decode issue in IIOImageProvider that can lead to a decompression-bomb denial of service (CVE-2026-89059). The second involves the CorsFilter reflecting arbitrary origins with credentials when configured with a wildcard, potentially allowing unauthorized cross-origin requests (CVE-2026-89058). These issues affect Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.2 Update Services for SAP Solutions and related variants. Red Hat has issued security updates to remediate these vulnerabilities.
